mission_08: Selection probabilities: probs = reputation / sum(reputation). Use np.random.choice with these probabilities to select min_silos silos
Reputation update: new_rep = (1 - alpha) * old_rep + alpha * improvement. Clip to [0.1, 2.0] to prevent extreme values
Effective weight for silo k: w_k = sample_size[k] * reputation[k]. Then global_w = sum(w_k * model_k) / sum(w_k)
